---
title: "About PopuliVerse"
---

PopuliVerse is one place to study populism, to follow what populist actors do and to publish on it: the universe of populism. It is in English, global in scope, academic in standard and readable by anyone.

## What Is Here

[The Library](../library/index.qmd)
: A database of research on populism, built for literature reviews.

[PopuliVerse Monitor](../monitor/index.qmd)
: A monthly digest of what populist actors did around the world.

[PopuliVerse Commentary](../commentary/index.qmd)
: Short commentary by scholars, four times a year.

[Resources](../resources/index.qmd)
: Links to datasets and other hubs.

## Who It Is For

Students and early-career researchers starting a literature review on populism. Scholars of populism who want a database and a regular update on populist actors. Journalists, policy staff and general readers who want to know what populists are doing, with sources.

## Editor

Editor: [Khayyam RZAZADE](editor.qmd)

PopuliVerse is independent. It is free to read and carries no advertising. It has no comments section and no user accounts.

How PopuliVerse works is set out in the [editorial policy](editorial-policy.qmd). To take part, see [how to contribute](contribute.qmd).
